Title: Collector server rollback and resume
Description: As a desktop user, I want a failed upload to leave no half-written batch in Cortexa, and a repeat upload to finish the job, handled inside the collector server.
AcceptanceCriteria: A failure before any ingestion.completed is published deletes written rows in reverse order (saga, provenance_maps, chunks, documents); not atomic across containers, best effort with errors logged by id
A publish failure after rows are written is never rolled back; replaying with the same Idempotency-Key republishes ingestion.completed (the orchestrator treats duplicates as already applied)
Error codes: 400/422 validation, 401/403 auth, 409 conflicting replay, 5xx storage or bus failure, each with a clear message
No pipeline retry for collector documents; re-upload is the recovery path (documented limit: web Retry stalls until the watchdog fails the batch)
All code for this story lives inside Cortexa-dev/desktop/collector; nothing in services/, contracts/, frontend/ or deploy/ is edited or referenced (outside logic is re-implemented inside)
TalkingPoints: Rollback deletes in reverse write order; after publish, the safe path is republish, not delete.

Tasks.Title: Reverse-order rollback
Tasks.Description: Track written rows and delete them in reverse order on failure before publish.

Tasks.Title: Republish on replay
Tasks.Description: Detect existing saga on replay and republish ingestion.completed for docs not yet Ingested.

Tasks.Title: Error mapping
Tasks.Description: Map validation, auth, conflict, storage and bus errors to status codes and messages.

Tasks.Title: Rollback tests
Tasks.Description: Fail at each write step and at publish; verify cleanup and replay.

Steps.Expected: No rows remain for the batch; 5xx returned

Tests.Title: Replay after publish failure finishes the batch

Steps.Action: Force a publish failure, then replay with the same key
Steps.Expected: ingestion.completed is published and the batch advances
